Shuhei Sakaguchi (Japanese: 阪口周平 Sakaguchi Shūhei) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Sakaguchi was born on September 5, 1977, in , , and became a voice actor as an adult. He joined the during , most notably providing the voice of Ridley. He was formerly affiliated with the talent agency , and is now affiliated with Aksent.
